mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extraction_task (task_id, document_id, status, total_chunks, processed_chunks, extracted_entities, extracted_relations, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{documentId}, #{status}, #{totalChunks}, #{processedChunks}, #{extractedEntities}, #{extractedRelations}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, document_id, status, total_chunks, processed_chunks, extracted_entities, extracted_relations, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM extraction_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT task_id, document_id, status, total_chunks, processed_chunks, extracted_entities, extracted_relations, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM extraction_task WHERE document_id = #{documentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE extraction_task SET status = #{status}, processed_chunks = #{processedChunks}, extracted_entities = #{extractedEntities}, extracted_relations = #{extractedRelations}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{updateTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
